Skills.Name: Canon of Cleanliness
Skills.Desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

Skills.Name: Scouring Anchor
Skills.Desc:
Swings her chain and anchor to deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to nearby opponents and summon a <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color>, an indispensable tool for any maid.
The <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> follows your own active character and assists in combat in different ways depending on whether or not Danica is on the field. If Danica is:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Off field</color>: The <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> performs a coordinated attack that deals <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> when your active character's <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> attacks hit an opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 1.5s;
·<color=#FFD780FF>On field</color>: Danica uses the <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> for her Normal Attacks, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion. She cannot perform Charged or Plunging Attacks.

Additionally, Danica can accumulate the special resource <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Cleanse</color> while the <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> is present. She gains this resource when another active character in your party hits an opponent with an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> or <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> attack, or when her own Normal Attacks using the <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> hit an opponent.
Once <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Cleanse</color> reaches its maximum, Danica can consume all her <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Cleanse</color> to use a special Elemental Skill based on whether or not she is on the field. If Danica is:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Off field</color>: Switching to Danica unleashes the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Protect</color>, creating a Royal Aegis and causing her to enter <color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Royal Guard</color> form;
·<color=#FFD780FF>On field</color>: Danica can use the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Purge</color> and enter <color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Cleaner</color> form.

Skills.Name: Rite to Cleanse the World
Skills.Desc:
Takes command of the battlefield as befits the Tsaritsa's trusted retainer, unleashing 5 consecutive attacks that each deal <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>:
·The first and fifth attacks deal additional <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG;
·For 20s after using her Elemental Burst, Danica also gains additional enhancements while in an <color=#FFD780FF>Attendant Form</color>, depending on the form she is in. If Danica is in:
<color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Royal Guard</color> form: Increases the ATK of all party members;
<color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Cleaner</color> form: Fills Danica's <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Cleanse</color> to its maximum and increases the DMG dealt by the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Purge</color>.
The corresponding enhancements are removed when Danica leaves her <color=#FFD780FF>Attendant Form</color>.

Passives.Name: Hymn of Ancient Waves
Passives.Desc: The <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> also reduces nearby opponents' <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> by 15%.\n<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: Opponents near the <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> have their <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro RES</color> reduced by an additional 15% and their <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo RES</color> reduced by 30%.

Passives.Name: Time to Clean House
Passives.Desc: After using <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Purge</color>, Danica gains 20% ATK SPD, and her Normal Attacks using the <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> grant her an additional 25 <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Cleanse</color> when they hit an opponent. The above effects can stack up to 3 times.\nDanica gains 20% ATK after using <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Protect</color>.\nEach of these effects lasts until its corresponding <color=#FFD780FF>Attendant Form</color> ends.

Passives.Name: Stellar Jubilee: Nothing Overlooked
Passives.Desc: When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct, and party members' Base Stellar-Conduct DMG will be increased based on Danica's ATK: Every 100 ATK she has increases the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.7%. The maximum increase that can be gained this way is 14%.\nAdditionally, when Danica is within a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>, she will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state.

Passives.Name: Unbothered by Frost and Snow
Passives.Desc: Increases your own party members' Movement SPD by 10% and reduces their Stamina consumption by 10% in extremely cold environments.

Constellations.Name: Service in the Frozen Palace
Constellations.Desc: Danica regenerates 20 Elemental Energy when she uses the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Purge</color> or <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Protect</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 14s.\nAdditionally, using the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Rite to Cleanse the World</color> increases the enhancements for <color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Cleaner</color> form by 120% and the enhancements for <color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Royal Guard</color> form by 80%.

Constellations.Name: Stillness Amid Searing Sands
Constellations.Desc:
Danica also grants 7 stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Let Us Toast</color> to all nearby party members when she uses her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Scouring Anchor</color>.
Characters with this effect consume 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Let Us Toast</color> when dealing Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, increasing that DMG by an amount equal to 100% of Danica's ATK.
Additionally, Danica consumes all her stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Let Us Toast</color> when she deals Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG in <color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Cleaner</color> form, increasing that DMG by an amount equal to 150% of her ATK.
Your own active character also gains 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Let Us Toast</color> when nearby party members consume a combined total of 6 stacks of <color=#FFD780FF>Let Us Toast</color>. Using the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Scouring Anchor</color> or the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Protect</color> resets the number of <color=#FFD780FF>Let Us Toast</color> stacks held by all nearby party members.

Constellations.Name: Shadow in a Forest of Blades
Constellations.Desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Rite to Cleanse the World</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

Constellations.Name: Shield in the Bitter Cold
Constellations.Desc: Other nearby party members regenerate 3 Elemental Energy when the active character protected by Royal Aegis deals Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG to an opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 3.5s.\nDanica also creates a Royal Aegis when she enters <color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Cleaner</color> form. This shield lasts until she leaves this form or leaves the field.

Constellations.Name: Mediation Amid Discord
Constellations.Desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>Scouring Anchor</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

Constellations.Name: The Star That Wakes Ere Dawn Breaks
Constellations.Desc:
Nearby party members' Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG is <color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color> by 20% while the <color=#FFD780FF>Storm Anchor</color> is present.
Additionally, Danica's <color=#FFD780FF>Attendant Forms</color> gain the following enhancements:
<color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Royal Guard</color> form: Increases the Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by your active character by 10% for every 1000 ATK Danica has, up to a maximum increase of 40%;
<color=#FFD780FF>Maid: Cleaner</color> form: Danica's special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Will to Purge</color> gains 2.5% CRIT Rate and 25% CRIT DMG for every 500 ATK she has. These bonuses are capped at 10% CRIT Rate and 100% CRIT DMG.
These form-specific enhancements last until Danica leaves the corresponding <color=#FFD780FF>Attendant Form</color>.
